description: PAID ($0.0045 USDC via x402, paid automatically). Scan text you are about to read — a fetched web page, an email, a tool description, another agent's message — for the shapes that hijack agents: instruction-override phrasing, a redefined system role or persona, requests to move credentials or keys, hidden directive tags and invisible Unicode. Returns a verdict (malicious / suspicious / no_known_pattern) and every pattern found with its severity. The same ruleset scans every FiatDock marketplace listing. Pattern-based: no_known_pattern is not a guarantee. Up to 8,000 characters per call; nothing is stored. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload you signed yourself. OPTIONAL: with AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY set, this tool pays automatically and you never need it. Use it to pay from a DIFFERENT wallet, or when no key is configured — call once without it to get the 402 (its body carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate`, the exact envelope to sign), then call again with it. When set it is sent as-is as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; no local signing and no price ceiling are applied.

text.description: The text to scan (up to 8,000 characters). Omit the whole body to scan the published example
